name: Small overruns, settled from a pool
title: Small overruns, settled from a pool
story: A card has a budget of 5.00 euro with 4.60 spent. A session on the big model needs 0.60, so the card stops and asks: Fund one more session? At manual and assisted the ask goes to you in Needs you. At autonomous and full auto the project agent wakes first. You set a small monthly pool for overruns (10 euro a month). 0.60 is small, so the agent funds one more session from the pool. A raise of 4.00 is too big for the agent: it reaches you with the agent's analysis.
